//go:build integration

package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	privatehttp "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/private"
	privatehandlers "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/private/handlers"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/generatedcourse"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/lesson"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/lessonrevision"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

// Root alone starts this helper in an already migrated disposable test database.
// Authored fixture text/answer is synthetic; hierarchy, revisions and HTTP are real.
// Unique fixture rows are retained for root evidence readback and database disposal.
func TestT14ServeLessonRevisionHTTP(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("T14_SERVE_COURSE") != "true" {
		t.Skip("owned T14 Course gate absent")
	}
	ready, stop, result := os.Getenv("T14_COURSE_READY_FILE"), os.Getenv("T14_COURSE_STOP_FILE"), os.Getenv("T14_COURSE_RESULT_FILE")
	token := os.Getenv("T14_COURSE_TOKEN")
	cfg, e := pgxpool.ParseConfig(os.Getenv("T14_COURSE_TEST_DATABASE_URL"))
	if e != nil || !strings.HasSuffix(cfg.ConnConfig.Database, "_test") || ready == "" || stop == "" || result == "" || token == "" {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: missing owned Course configuration")
	}
	if _, e = os.Stat(stop); !os.IsNotExist(e) {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: stop marker must be absent")
	}
	ctx := context.Background()
	pool, e := pgxpool.NewWithConfig(ctx, cfg)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: Course pool unavailable")
	}
	defer pool.Close()
	if pool.Ping(ctx) != nil {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: Course database unavailable")
	}
	var count int
	if pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT count(*) FROM code_structure_type WHERE code='QUIZ_TEXT_BASIC'`).Scan(&count) != nil || count != 1 {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: missing Course reference seed")
	}
	lessons := LessonRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	translations := LessonI18nRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	tasks := TaskRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	examples := LessonExampleRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	revisions := lessonrevision.Definitions{
		Revisions: LessonRevisionRepoPG{Pool: pool}, Lessons: lessons, Translations: translations,
		Tasks: tasks, Tests: TaskTestRepoPG{Pool: pool}, Files: TaskFileStorageRepoPG{Pool: pool},
		Examples: examples, Tx: LessonRevisionTxPG{Pool: pool},
	}
	ensure := generatedcourse.Ensure{
		Revisions: revisions, Generated: GeneratedCourseRepoPG{Pool: pool},
		Courses: CourseRepoPG{Pool: pool}, CourseI18n: CourseI18nRepoPG{Pool: pool},
		Modules: ModuleRepoPG{Pool: pool}, ModuleI18n: ModuleI18nRepoPG{Pool: pool}, CourseModules: CourseModuleRepoPG{Pool: pool},
		Sections: SectionRepoPG{Pool: pool}, SectionI18n: SectionI18nRepoPG{Pool: pool}, ModuleSections: ModuleSectionRepoPG{Pool: pool},
		Lessons: lessons, LessonI18n: translations, SectionLessons: SectionLessonRepoPG{Pool: pool},
		Examples: examples, Tasks: tasks, TaskI18n: TaskI18nRepoPG{Pool: pool}, TaskTargets: TaskLearningTargetRepoPG{Pool: pool},
		StructureTypes: CodeStructureTypeRepoPG{Pool: pool}, I18n: I18nRepoPG{Pool: pool}, Tx: TxManagerPG{Pool: pool},
		IDs: t14CourseIDs{}, Clock: t14CourseClock{},
	}

	authored := t14AuthoredFixture()
	nonce := sha256.Sum256([]byte(uuid.NewString()))
	authored.Fingerprint = hex.EncodeToString(nonce[:])
	// Synthetic R1 source deliberately differs from R2 in every projected field.
	authored.Modules[0].Sections[0].Lessons[0].Title = "Frozen R1 exact title"
	authored.Modules[0].Sections[0].Lessons[0].Excerpt = "Frozen R1 exact excerpt"
	authored.Modules[0].Sections[0].Lessons[0].DescriptionMarkdown = "# Frozen R1\n\nKeep the exact selected fragment unchanged."
	created, e := ensure.Handle(ctx, uuid.NewString(), authored)
	if e != nil || len(created.Lessons) != 1 {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: actual Course authored fixture usecase failed")
	}
	lessonID, courseID := created.Lessons[0].LessonID, created.CourseID
	r1, e := revisions.Get(ctx, created.Lessons[0].LessonRevisionID)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: actual Course R1 receipt missing")
	}
	// The mounted assigned lesson screen requires an authored theory activity.
	// Configure it through Course's existing owner usecase while retaining the
	// generated quiz activity. Resolve publishes a new immutable chosen R1;
	// neither the initial generated receipt nor its immutable definition changes.
	initialGeneratedRevision := r1.LessonRevisionID
	policy := append([]domain.LessonActivity(nil), r1.Activities...)
	policy = append(policy, domain.LessonActivity{ActivityID: uuid.NewString(), Type: domain.ActivityTheoryAcknowledged, Required: true, SourceReference: domain.ActivitySourceReference{ID: lessonID}})
	if e = revisions.SetPolicy(ctx, lessonID, policy); e != nil {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: actual Course authored theory policy usecase failed")
	}
	r1, e = revisions.Resolve(ctx, lessonID)
	if e != nil || r1.LessonRevisionID == initialGeneratedRevision {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: authored theory policy did not publish a new immutable R1")
	}
	initial, e := revisions.Get(ctx, initialGeneratedRevision)
	if e != nil || len(initial.Activities) != len(policy)-1 || len(r1.Activities) != len(policy) {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: original generated revision changed or required policy missing")
	}
	digest := func(r *domain.LessonRevision) string {
		raw, _ := json.Marshal([3]string{r.Content.Title, r.Content.Excerpt, r.Content.Description})
		s := sha256.Sum256(raw)
		return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(s[:])
	}
	var mu sync.Mutex
	var r2 *domain.LessonRevision
	metadata := func() map[string]any {
		v := map[string]any{"url": "", "course_id": courseID, "lesson_id": lessonID, "revision_r1": r1.LessonRevisionID, "digest_r1": digest(r1), "initial_generated_revision": initialGeneratedRevision, "theory_requirement_authored": true, "classification": "actual generated-course owner usecase/PG; actual Definitions.SetPolicy preserves quiz and adds authored required theory; Resolve publishes immutable chosen R1 while initial generated receipt is retained; registered revision HTTP; synthetic authored text and quiz; no NATS or LLM"}
		if r2 != nil {
			v["revision_r2"] = r2.LessonRevisionID
			v["digest_r2"] = digest(r2)
		}
		return v
	}
	registered := chi.NewRouter()
	registered.Mount("/internal", privatehttp.NewRouter(nil, &privatehandlers.LessonHandler{RevisionsUC: revisions, TeacherContextUC: lesson.GetTeacherContext{Lessons: lessons, LessonI18n: translations}}, nil, nil, token, "", ""))
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /__t14/publish-r2", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if r.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") != token {
			w.WriteHeader(401)
			return
		}
		mu.Lock()
		defer mu.Unlock()
		if r2 == nil {
			_, err := (lesson.UpdateLesson{Lessons: lessons, Tasks: tasks, LessonI18n: translations, Tx: TxManagerPG{Pool: pool}}).Handle(r.Context(), lesson.UpdateLessonInput{LessonID: lessonID, Title: "Published R2 title", Excerpt: "Published R2 excerpt", Description: "# Published R2\n\nThe replacement fragment differs.", Status: domain.LessonStatusActive})
			if err == nil {
				r2, err = revisions.Resolve(r.Context(), lessonID)
			}
			if err != nil {
				w.WriteHeader(500)
				return
			}
			old, err := revisions.Get(r.Context(), r1.LessonRevisionID)
			if err != nil || digest(old) != digest(r1) || r2.LessonRevisionID == r1.LessonRevisionID || digest(r2) == digest(r1) {
				w.WriteHeader(500)
				return
			}
		}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(metadata())
	})
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /__t14/inspect", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if r.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") != token {
			w.WriteHeader(401)
			return
		}
		mu.Lock()
		defer mu.Unlock()
		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(metadata())
	})
	mux.Handle("/", registered)
	server := httptest.NewServer(mux)
	defer server.Close()
	v := metadata()
	v["url"] = server.URL
	t14CourseWrite(t, ready, v)
	ticker := time.NewTicker(100 * time.Millisecond)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	deadline := time.NewTimer(30 * time.Minute)
	defer deadline.Stop()
	for {
		select {
		case <-deadline.C:
			t.Fatal("owned Course deadline exceeded")
		case <-ticker.C:
			if _, err := os.Stat(stop); err == nil {
				mu.Lock()
				v = metadata()
				mu.Unlock()
				v["url"] = server.URL
				t14CourseWrite(t, result, v)
				return
			} else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
				t.Fatal("owned stop read failed")
			}
		}
	}
}
func t14CourseWrite(t *testing.T, path string, value any) {
	t.Helper()
	raw, e := json.MarshalIndent(value, "", "  ")
	if e != nil || os.WriteFile(path+".tmp", append(raw, '\n'), 0600) != nil || os.Rename(path+".tmp", path) != nil {
		t.Fatal("safe metadata export failed")
	}
}

type t14CourseIDs struct{}

func (t14CourseIDs) NewID() string { return uuid.NewString() }

type t14CourseClock struct{}

func (t14CourseClock) Now() time.Time { return time.Now().UTC() }
func t14AuthoredFixture() domain.GeneratedCourse {
	firstTarget := domain.CourseTargetRef{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.syntax", Version: "v1"}
	secondTarget := domain.CourseTargetRef{Type: domain.LearningTargetCapability, Key: "go.errors", Version: "v1"}
	return domain.GeneratedCourse{
		Fingerprint:        "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",
		FingerprintVersion: "course-fingerprint-v1", GoalCode: "go.backend", GoalVersion: "v1",
		Title: "Go Backend", Description: "Go for backend developers.", Language: "ru",
		Status: "ACTIVE", CatalogVisible: false, PlannerVersion: "course-planner-v1",
		PedagogyProfile: "standard-v1", PresentationStyle: "standard-v1", GenerationPolicy: "shared-v1",
		Modules: []domain.GeneratedCourseModule{{
			Code: "foundation", Title: "Foundation", Order: 0,
			Sections: []domain.GeneratedCourseSection{{
				Code: "language", Title: "Language", Order: 0,
				Lessons: []domain.GeneratedCourseLesson{{
					Code: "errors", Title: "Errors", Excerpt: "Explicit errors.", Order: 0, Status: "ACTIVE",
					Targets:       []domain.CourseTargetRef{firstTarget, secondTarget},
					Prerequisites: []domain.CourseTargetRef{firstTarget},
					TransitionKnowledge: []domain.CourseTransitionKnowledge{{
						SourceStack: "php", Target: secondTarget, Similarity: "Control flow.",
						Difference: "Explicit values.", AnalogyBoundary: "No unwinding.",
					}},
					PedagogyStrategies:  []domain.CoursePedagogyStrategyRef{{Code: "explicit_instruction", Version: 1}},
					DescriptionMarkdown: "# Explicit errors\n\nHandle errors as values.",
					Examples: []domain.GeneratedCourseExample{{
						Title: "Check an error", DescriptionMarkdown: "```go\nif err != nil {}\n```",
						PrimaryStack: "go", Stacks: []string{"go"}, TargetConcepts: []string{"errors"},
					}},
					Tasks: []domain.GeneratedCourseTask{{
						Title: "Error check", DescriptionMarkdown: "How are errors handled?",
						ExpectedAnswers: []string{"as values"},
					}},
				}},
			}},
		}},
	}
}
